content: Control of the House depends on which party reaches 218 seats. Currently, 219 members caucus with Republicans, one more than the minimum needed for a majority when all seats are filled. There are two vacancies now.

content: The elections were a nationwide verdict on Trump's turbulent second term, with discontent over living costs, tariffs and the US war against Iran, weighing on Republicans as his approval ratings languish near record lows.

title: US Midterms 2026 Live Updates: Democrats Take Control Of US Senate, Trump Fires Back With "Veto" Post
content: US Midterm Elections Results 2026 Live: The election serves as a broad referendum on Trump's presidency, with voter sentiment shifting against the Republican party.

title: Republican Byron Donalds Elected Florida's First Black Governor
content: Byron Donalds, a staunch Trump ally, will succeed outgoing Republican Governor Ron DeSantis, who used the office to fan presidential ambitions and steer the nation's third-most populous state further to the right.

title: Democrats Take Control Of US Congress. What It Means For India
content: With Democrats controlling both chambers in the midterms, they gain stronger leverage over legislation, investigations and funding.

title: Democrat Roy Cooper Wins North Carolina Senate Seat, Defeating Trump's Pick
content: Former North Carolina Governor Roy Cooper said he would push to bring down the cost of gas and groceries, end the war in Iran, and take on corruption and special interests.

title: US gets its first Muslim Senator: Abdul El-Sayed wins from Michigan, has India link
content: Abdul El-Sayed has won the US Senate seat in Michigan, defeating Mike Rogers in the recent election. His campaign focused on universal healthcare and ensuring government accountability for all citizens. El-Sayed's victory follows a close primary race against Congresswoman Haley Stevens earlier this year. He aims to be a representative for Michigan’s diverse electorate and is poised to become the first Muslim senator.

title: Hours after mid-term election results, Musk sends 'let's go to Space' message
content: Elon Musk expressed interest in building data centers in space after the mid-term elections favored Democrats. His posts came after significant Democratic gains, including a surprise victory in Texas' governor's race. Democrats' success has drawn attention to the AI industry's impact on data infrastructure expansions. Musk's remarks hint at the growing scrutiny over the environmental effects of data centers. The mid-term elections also celebrated historic milestones in American political representation.

title: Texas railroad commission race: Bo French, Republican who sparked anti-India row, defeated
content: Jon Rosenthal, representing the Democratic Party, has made a significant breakthrough by winning the Texas Railroad Commission, marking a notable end to Republican rule. This election, intensified by Bo French's divisive comments about South Asian students, has captured national headlines. Rosenthal aims to implement stricter regulatory measures for the oil and gas industry, drawing on his experience as a former engineer and commitment to environmental enhancement in Texas.

title: Katy Perry's 110-acre California youth camp faces opposition from 360 neighbours
content: Katy Perry’s proposed Gratitude Canyon youth camp in Goleta, California, is facing opposition from more than 360 neighbours. Residents have raised concerns about wildfire risks, traffic, noise and evacuation access. The singer’s Firework Foundation is defending the project, saying it will provide underserved children with opportunities to explore arts, nature and outdoor activities.

title: Tennessee couple loses land claim despite 30 years of mowing and gardening
content: A couple from Tennessee faced a setback as their claim over a strip of land beside their house was overturned by the court. They believed their usage spanning almost 30 years sufficed for establishing ownership through adverse possession. However, the appeals court determined that the couple's evidence fell short of legal standards, highlighting a vital legal principle: merely using land for an extended period does not guarantee ownership.

title: Washington sisters lose fence boundary dispute; court orders one fence removed
content: Two sisters in Washington, US, lost a property dispute involving fences on both sides of their home after a survey revealed discrepancies in the boundary lines. The Washington Court of Appeals upheld rulings favouring both neighbours, including an order to remove a fence encroaching on one neighbour's land. The court also upheld legal-fee awards and granted the neighbours additional fees for the appeal.

title: Priscilla Chan marks 10 years of island work with $100 million pledge in letter
content: Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan have celebrated ten years of philanthropy on the island of Kauaʻi. They have committed over $100 million to more than 100 local organizations since 2016. Their philanthropic focus includes health, housing, education, and emergency relief initiatives supporting the local community. Chan emphasized the importance of listening to our community for better engagement in charitable efforts.

title: Georgia firm pays $220,000 for nonexistent land, loses bid for refund
content: Talon Assets, LLC acquired land in Atlanta for $220,000 at a county tax sale. Doubts about the property led them to request a refund and tax deed cancellation. However, Fulton County dismissed their case, invoking sovereign immunity as a legal defense. The Georgia Court of Appeals upheld this dismissal, leaving Talon's issues unresolved. This ruling highlights the challenges in pursuing financial claims against county governments in Georgia.

title: Thief glues woman’s hands, grabs Rs 4.5L gold chain in Bengaluru
content: During the weekend, a man named Prabhuraj entered a shoe repair shop in Indiranagar. He threatened the employee, Jayashree, with a knife and applied superglue to her hands. After immobilizing her, he stole her gold mangalsutra worth Rs 4.5 lakh. Members of the public chased him, leading to his arrest after a dramatic encounter. Police reported that Jayashree was safe and unhurt following the incident.

title: Arshdeep joins Srinath and Shami in elite list as India bowl out NZ for 185
content: Arshdeep's spell is the fourth-best by an Indian pacer in New Zealand. Srinath holds the top two positions with figures of 4/23 in Auckland in 2003 and 4/52 in Napier in 1995. Shami is third with 4/55 in Napier in 2014.

title: Atmanirbharta key to strategic autonomy must mean technological sovereignty says Rajnath
content: India's Defence Minister Rajnath Singh emphasized the importance of indigenous weapons development during the Delhi Defence Dialogue. He stated that self-reliance in defense means reducing external dependencies while improving technological capabilities. The government aims to increase defense production and exports significantly by 2029 through enhanced private participation and collaboration. Additionally, he highlighted the need for armed forces involvement in research and development to drive innovation.

title: Pakistan tests Fa'az air-to-air missile, but reach and speed remain a mystery
content: Pakistan has announced the successful test flight of its indigenously developed air-to-air missile called Fa'az. This missile features a terminal guidance system, designed for engaging aerial targets at long ranges. The flight test was observed by military officials and scientists involved in its development. Simultaneously, India is working on its own Astra family of missiles to enhance air defense capabilities.

title: Historic 1st in US midterms: Black, Indigenous, Latina & LGBTQ leaders win key races
content: The 2026 US midterm elections have led to historic firsts in gubernatorial and Senate races across the nation. Notable victories include the first Black woman governor in US history and the first Native American woman governor. The election of Texas' first Latina governor and Florida's first Black governor also signify progress in representation. Additionally, Minnesota has elected its first woman governor, further enhancing diversity in leadership roles.

title: US midterms: Red alert for Republicans as Democrats notch stunning flips
content: The 2026 US midterm elections saw a significant turnaround for the Democrats, who successfully overturned several Republican-held positions. They secured a vital Senate seat in North Carolina and won the governorship in Georgia. Gains in Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Kentucky, and Iowa underscored a shift in political dynamics, with Roy Cooper and Annie Andrews emerging victorious in their Senate races. These outcomes herald a challenging phase for Trump's party.

title: Teacher killed, body kept in car boot for hours; UP school manager arrested
content: Deoria police arrested a school manager for allegedly killing a teacher who demanded marriage. The accused, Vijay Nishad, reportedly strangled Rani Vishwakarma following an argument in his car. After committing the crime, he hid her body in the vehicle's boot and disposed of it near a school. Police reconstructed the events from his confession and gathered evidence from the scene.

title: Spain transport minister Óscar Puente quits 6 days after train disaster kills 69
content: Spain’s transport minister Óscar Puente resigned after a high-speed train collision near Madrid caused 69 fatalities. This incident was the second major rail disaster on the Madrid-Seville route in just one year. Following the October 28 crash, Puente faced pressure from opposition politicians and railway unions demanding his resignation. He acknowledged responsibility for the accidents and announced measures to improve railway safety.

title: Fires are down in Punjab but most being lit at dusk
content: Farmers in Punjab are opting to ignite stubble fires during the evening hours, believing these flames will slip under the radar of satellites and officials. This trend has caught on within the farming community, leading to a noticeable drop in detected fire incidents. Many farmers are using this tactic to sidestep penalties associated with stubble burning.

title: Accused in Guwahati hotel shooting shot dead in encounter
content: Ghanakanta Gogoi was killed in police firing while attempting to escape from custody in Sivasagar. The incident occurred after he snatched a police officer's weapon and shot at the police. Gogoi had previously surrendered to police with a firearm linked to the Hotel Bilas Inn shooting. This shooting resulted in the deaths of five individuals connected to the hotel.

title: North Korea fires missiles hours after rejecting US accusations over Binance hack
content: North Korea recently fired multiple missiles towards its eastern waters, indicating rising tensions with South Korea and the US. This action followed North Korea's denial of involvement in a significant cryptocurrency hack attributed to its hackers by the FBI. Kim Yo Jong criticized US accusations as part of a hostile policy and refused dialogue until it changes.

title: How does Trump's defeat in US midterms impact Indian stock market? Explained
content: Indian equities are already contending with a range of domestic market pressures. Uncertainty surrounding Donald Trump's tariff decisions, higher crude oil prices and bond yields, along with sustained foreign institutional investor (FII) selling, has pushed the Sensex and Nifty down. In this environment, investors are watching the US midterm elections for clues about their possible impact on global financial markets.

title: Telangana woman dragged to in-laws’ home, beheaded over 1.5-acre land dispute
content: Sunitha, a 28-year-old woman, was murdered by her in-laws due to a land dispute in Mahbubnagar. They were allegedly angered by the transfer of 1.5 acres of land registered in her name. Sunitha's in-laws dragged her to their home and brutally beheaded her. The police launched an investigation after her father reported the incident. The accused are currently absconding, and special teams are working to locate them.

title: ACP who led police protest suspended
content: Assistant Commissioner Manasvi Vashistha was suspended for protesting his transfer along with Inspector Arun Kumar. The protest occurred after an incident involving lawyers at Shahdara police station, resulting in a serious injury to an advocate. Vashistha had previously called for clearer procedures for interactions between police and lawyers. He led the demonstration, which was dismissed as an interaction by the police.

title: November pain: Air quality severe in parts of Delhi
content: At 4pm on Tuesday, Delhi's air quality index fell to a concerning level of 350, with certain areas like Jahangirpuri reporting a hazardous AQI of 462. Monitoring agencies warn that the city's air quality may worsen, largely due to rising emissions from stubble burning in nearby states. Experts predict that the adverse weather conditions will result in six more days of poor air quality across the region.

title: 'Aren't we secular?' HC asks BMC to restore actor Dia Mirza's anti-cracker post
content: Bombay High Court expressed disappointment over BMC's removal of an anti-cracker video featuring actor Dia Mirza. The court highlighted the importance of public participation in addressing pollution and suggested reinstating the video. Additionally, judges were disturbed by negative comments concerning celebrities engaged in public awareness efforts. They emphasized the need for support during such initiatives, especially when guided by court directions.

title: Virat Kohli's stunning catch, Rohit Sharma's run-out lights up Auckland ODI
content: Kohli took a low catch at second slip to dismiss Nathan Smith in the 29th over off Anshul Kamboj, reducing New Zealand to 115/7.

title: US poll results: Democrat Amy Acton defeats Ramaswamy, flips Ohio governor's office
content: Dr. Amy Acton has been elected as Ohio's first female governor after defeating Vivek Ramaswamy. This historic victory marks the first Democratic win in the state's governorship in two decades. Acton campaigned on healthcare and affordability while highlighting her challenging childhood. Ramaswamy faced significant backlash for a controversial ad featuring Acton's estranged mother. Acton enters office without prior elected experience amid significant political shifts in Ohio.

title: ‘India went through a dark phase’: Sachin Tendulkar opens up on captaincy stint
content: In a recent social media session, cricket legend Sachin Tendulkar shared insights about his captaincy during the 1990s, highlighting the hurdles he encountered, particularly in team selection. He named Sourav Ganguly and MS Dhoni as his top Indian captain picks for their impactful leadership. Tendulkar also commended South Africa's Temba Bavuma for his extraordinary results and leadership qualities, showcasing the value of strategic guidance in cricket.

title: 'Tall and quick': Shubman Gill's choice of pacers for 2027 World Cup
content: On the eve of India’s opening ODI against New Zealand at the Eden Park, Auckland, the Indian skipper laid bare the blueprint behind India’s recent pace-bowling auditions, pegging tall, hit-the-deck quicks as a core priority with an eye on the 2027 World Cup in South Africa.

title: Why a desi family is following bid of El-Sayed to make US Senate history
content: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed is competing against Republican Mike Rogers in the Michigan Senate race. If elected, El-Sayed will become the first Muslim US senator. His wife, Dr. Sarah Jukaku, is connected to Bhatkal, Karnataka, through her heritage. Their family expresses pride in El-Sayed's commitment to public service, mirroring the values of Jukaku Shamshuddin. They are closely following the political developments of El-Sayed's campaign.
